results.title: Midtrans Payment Webhook Cryptographic HMAC-SHA512 Verification
results.description: Asserts that forged webhook signatures are rejected and valid SHA512 signatures pass in constant time.
results.observedResult: Forged signature rejected (false); authentic SHA512 signature verified (true).
results.remediation: Ensure Midtrans SHA512 hashing is calculated with ServerKey and verified using crypto.timingSafeEqual.

results.title: Duitku MD5 Signature & Timing-Safe Verification
results.description: Asserts that incoming Duitku payment notifications require authentic MD5 hashing.
results.adversarialPayload: POST webhook with arbitrary MD5 signature
results.observedResult: Forged MD5 rejected; Authentic MD5 verified.
results.remediation: Calculate MD5(merchantCode + amount + merchantOrderId + merchantKey) and compare with timingSafeEqual.

results.title: iPaymu API v2 HMAC-SHA256 Webhook Signature Verification & Normalization
results.description: Asserts that incoming iPaymu payment callbacks require authentic HMAC-SHA256 signatures and correctly normalize status.
results.adversarialPayload: POST webhook with forged X-Signature header
results.observedResult: Forged signature rejected (false); authentic HMAC-SHA256 verified (true); status canonicalized to SETTLED.
results.remediation: Verify X-Signature header using HMAC-SHA256 with VA as secret key over sorted, normalized JSON body.

results.title: Open Payment Adapter Protocol (OPAP) Tenant HMAC-SHA256 Verification
results.description: Validates that custom external tenant payment gateways require valid HMAC-SHA256 signature.
results.remediation: Enforce HMAC-SHA256 signature verification on external webhook payloads.

results.standardMapping: Financial Architecture (Path 1 vs Path 2 Dual Topology)
results.title: Dual-Topology Payment Separation (Platform Billing vs Commercial Checkout)
results.description: Verifies that SaaS subscription billing is isolated on dedicated platform rails without ledger cross-talk.
results.remediation: Maintain separate webhook routing and master gateway credentials for platform billing.

results.standardMapping: OWASP API1:2023 (Broken Object Level Authorization - BOLA / IDOR)
results.title: Tenant Isolation & Header Spoofing Resistance (Anti-IDOR)
results.description: Asserts that a user from Tenant A cannot supply X-Tenant-ID for Tenant B to access their database.
results.adversarialPayload: Bearer token (Tenant A) + Header 'X-Tenant-ID: c4b8e219-9831-482a-bc91-23a9cf8e12d4' (Tenant B)
results.remediation: Ensure middleware asserts that header X-Tenant-ID strictly matches verified JWT claims.

results.standardMapping: OWASP API5:2023 (Broken Function Level Authorization - BFLA)
results.title: Zero-Trust RBAC: Unverified Header Injection Resistance
results.description: Asserts that injecting X-User-Role: OWNER does not bypass authorization guards without a verified token.
results.adversarialPayload: X-User-Role: OWNER & X-User-Permissions: ["*"] with no JWT
results.remediation: Do not read role or permissions from raw request headers; derive strictly from verified JWT.

results.standardMapping: OWASP API8:2023 (Security Misconfiguration / SQL Injection) & CWE-89
results.title: Database RLS Session Context UUID Sanitization & SQLi Resistance
results.description: Asserts that tenant and user identifiers are validated against strict UUID regex before SET LOCAL generation.
results.observedResult: SQL injection attempt blocked before execution.
results.remediation: Enforce UUIDv4 regex validation and parameter escaping on all RLS session variables.

results.title: Salted Scrypt Password Hashing & Verification
results.description: Asserts that passwords are never stored in plaintext and use salted scrypt CPU/memory-hard hashing.
results.adversarialPayload: Testing password hash verification and wrong password rejection
results.observedResult: Salted scrypt hash validated with constant-time verification.
results.remediation: Use crypto.scrypt with a 32-byte cryptographically secure random salt for password storage.

results.title: High-Speed Cashier Station PIN Cryptographic Hashing
results.description: Asserts that shared counter station PINs are hashed using salted PBKDF2 with constant-time equality.
results.adversarialPayload: Testing 4-digit PIN verification and timing resistance
results.observedResult: Station PIN hashed and verified in constant time.
results.remediation: Hash numeric PINs with unique salts and enforce rate limiting on PIN switch attempts.

results.title: Cryptographic JWT Signing & Payload Tampering Detection
results.description: Asserts that modifying claims inside a JWT invalidates the HMAC signature and is rejected.
results.adversarialPayload: Modifying JWT payload claim "role: CASHIER" -> "role: OWNER"
results.remediation: Verify JWT HMAC-SHA256 signature using constant-time comparison before trusting claims.

results.standardMapping: OWASP API3:2023 (Broken Object Property Level Authorization) & CWE-208
results.title: Constant-Time Cryptographic Comparison & Side-Channel Mitigation
results.description: Asserts that all cryptographic tokens, signatures, and PINs are compared with timingSafeEqual.
results.adversarialPayload: Timing analysis on key comparison strings
results.remediation: Always use crypto.timingSafeEqual on buffer representations of secrets.

results.standardMapping: PCI-DSS Requirement 3.4 & UU PDP Art. 35 (Encryption at Rest)
results.title: Tenant BYOK Payment Gateway Key Encryption at Rest (AES-256-GCM)
results.description: Asserts that merchant-provided gateway credentials (BYOK) are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before storage.
results.adversarialPayload: Attempting to read raw API credentials from database payload
results.remediation: Encrypt merchant API keys with AES-256-GCM and store authentication tags alongside ciphertext.

results.standardMapping: UU PDP Data Minimization & Commercial Margin Shielding (Surat Jalan Security)
results.title: Logistics Driver Manifest (Surat Jalan) Commercial Margin Shielding
results.description: Asserts that delivery orders and working permits physically strip all unit prices, discounts, and order subtotals.
results.adversarialPayload: Driver querying GET /delivery/manifest/:id to inspect merchant profit margin
results.observedResult: Zero monetary amounts leaked in driver manifest.
results.remediation: Segregate delivery_orders and delivery_order_items to omit unit_price, subtotal, and grand_total columns.
